'''Voltmare''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Surgehoof]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Boltallion]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Voltmare has slowly adjusted to the rules of this new world and developed a unique logic to understand those within it. The child poses no threat, but the old man and the rest are far less certain."

Voltmare is a red rarity Tatari. 

==Appearance==
A spiky, purple unicorn with golden lightning accents. It has an angry expression at all times. It also has a golden horn, ears, eyes, hooves, and electrical spiky mane and tail. 

Voltmare's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces gold with green-blue.

== Evolution Trial ==
Voltmare's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Boltallion]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Marathon Party]] (use skateboard x6000) or [[Fishing Contest]] (use Fishing Rod x6000).
* Own 24-Star Lightning Tatari x4.

==Strategy==
[[File:Voltmare Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Voltmare's attack range]]
Voltmare is a strong Lightning DPS. It is best placed in solid Water lanes to get the most out of its splash effect. 
{{clear|left}}

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "People ask to ride Voltmare. I tell them death by electricity has been outlawed."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "When sprinting at full speed, Voltmare can tear a lightning fissure through the ground. Legend says the charging stance is so magnificent that enemies forget to dodge."
